posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: The 515 crores received from CGFMU has not been written back and has instead been used to create a contingency provision buffer for any unforseen future macro/geopolitical events. Thus it has been excluded from Q1 profits. If it were included in Q1 profits - the the profit figure of Q1 would have been around 1460 crores.
